title: RAG Vector Store Integrations
summary: This module provides tools and adapters for integrating various vector databases like LanceDB, Couchbase, MongoDB, Qdrant, and Weaviate into RAG workflows. It defines core abstractions for embedding functions and collection management, enabling efficient document storage and retrieval.

nodes.label: Manage RAG Configuration
nodes.title: RAG Configuration Manager
nodes.description: Handles global RAG configuration settings and dynamically loads RAG submodules, ensuring proper setup for vector store integrations.

nodes.label: Dispatch RAG Client Creation
nodes.title: RAG Client Dispatcher
nodes.description: Acts as a central factory to create and configure RAG clients for various providers like ChromaDB and Qdrant based on the specified configuration.

nodes.label: Define Embedding Function Interface
nodes.title: Embedding Function Protocol
nodes.description: Establishes a standard protocol for functions that convert input data (text or images) into vector embeddings, ensuring consistency across different embedding models.

nodes.label: Specify Document Addition Parameters
nodes.title: Document Addition Parameters
nodes.description: Defines the necessary parameters and structure for adding documents, including their content and metadata, to a RAG collection.

nodes.label: Specify Search Query Parameters
nodes.title: Search Query Parameters
nodes.description: Outlines the parameters required for performing a search query against a RAG collection, such as the query string, limits, and filters.

nodes.label: Provide Default ChromaDB Settings
nodes.title: ChromaDB Settings Provider
nodes.description: Generates and manages default configuration settings for ChromaDB, including persistence directory and reset options, to ensure a consistent setup.

nodes.label: Build ChromaDB Client
nodes.title: ChromaDB Client Builder
nodes.description: Constructs and initializes a ChromaDB client instance, handling persistent storage, settings, and tenant/database configurations for RAG operations.

nodes.label: Provide Default Qdrant Options
nodes.title: Qdrant Options Provider
nodes.description: Supplies default client options for Qdrant, primarily focusing on file-based storage paths for local Qdrant instances.

nodes.label: Adapt Qdrant Embedding Function
nodes.title: Qdrant Embedding Adapter
nodes.description: A wrapper class that adapts Qdrant's embedding function to conform to the internal `EmbeddingFunction` protocol, enabling Pydantic validation.

nodes.label: Define High-Level Qdrant Collection Params
nodes.title: Qdrant Collection Parameters (High-Level)
nodes.description: Specifies high-level parameters for creating a Qdrant collection, abstracting away some of the underlying Qdrant client details.

nodes.label: Define Low-Level Qdrant Collection Params
nodes.title: Qdrant Collection Parameters (Low-Level)
nodes.description: Details the specific parameters required by the Qdrant client's `create_collection` method, including the collection name and other configuration fields.

nodes.label: Integrate with LanceDB
nodes.title: LanceDB Integration Adapter
nodes.description: An adapter that facilitates RAG operations with LanceDB, handling embedding generation, querying, and document addition to a LanceDB table.

nodes.label: Provide Generic RAG Adapter
nodes.title: Generic RAG Adapter
nodes.description: A general-purpose RAG adapter that abstracts the underlying RAG client, allowing for flexible integration with various vector stores configured through the RAG module.

nodes.label: Search Couchbase FTS Vector Store
nodes.title: Couchbase FTS Vector Search Tool
nodes.description: A specialized tool for performing vector-based full-text searches within a Couchbase database, leveraging its FTS capabilities and custom embedding functions.

nodes.label: Search MongoDB Vector Store
nodes.title: MongoDB Vector Search Tool
nodes.description: A tool designed for executing vector searches against a MongoDB database, utilizing OpenAI embeddings and Atlas Search vector indexes for efficient retrieval.

nodes.label: Search Qdrant Vector Store
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Search Tool
nodes.description: A dedicated tool for performing vector similarity searches in a Qdrant vector database, supporting custom embedding functions and query filtering.

nodes.label: Search Weaviate Vector Store
nodes.title: Weaviate Vector Search Tool
nodes.description: A tool to query a Weaviate vector database, enabling hybrid searches and leveraging OpenAI for embedding generation and generative models.

nodes.label: OpenAI Embedding Service
nodes.title: OpenAI Embedding Service
nodes.description: External service providing text embedding capabilities, used by various vector store integrations to convert text into vector representations.

nodes.label: LanceDB Vector Store
nodes.title: LanceDB Vector Store
nodes.description: An external, file-based vector database optimized for local and embedded use cases, integrated for RAG operations.

nodes.label: Couchbase Database
nodes.title: Couchbase Database
nodes.description: An external NoSQL document database with Full-Text Search and vector search capabilities, used for storing and retrieving RAG documents.

nodes.label: MongoDB Database
nodes.title: MongoDB Database
nodes.description: An external NoSQL document database, integrated for vector search capabilities via Atlas Search, storing RAG documents and their embeddings.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Database
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Database
nodes.description: An external high-performance vector similarity search engine, used for storing and querying vector embeddings for RAG.

nodes.label: Weaviate Vector Database
nodes.title: Weaviate Vector Database
nodes.description: An external open-source vector database that supports semantic search, integrated for storing and retrieving RAG documents and their embeddings.

groups.label: Core RAG Abstractions
groups.title: Core RAG Abstractions
groups.description: Fundamental components defining the RAG framework, including configuration management, client dispatch, and interface definitions for embeddings and collection operations.

groups.label: ChromaDB Integration
groups.title: ChromaDB Integration
groups.description: Components specifically designed for integrating and managing ChromaDB as a vector store within the RAG system.

groups.label: Qdrant Integration Components
groups.title: Qdrant Integration Components
groups.description: Specific components for configuring and interacting with Qdrant, including default options, embedding function adaptation, and collection parameter definitions.

groups.label: Vector Store Adapters
groups.title: Vector Store Adapters
groups.description: Generic and specific adapters that provide a standardized interface for RAG operations with different vector databases.

groups.label: Vector Store Search Tools
groups.title: Vector Store Search Tools
groups.description: Specialized tools that enable agents to perform vector-based searches against various external vector databases.

groups.label: External Vector Stores
groups.title: External Vector Stores
groups.description: External database services used for storing and retrieving vector embeddings and associated documents for RAG operations.

groups.label: External Embedding Services
groups.title: External Embedding Services
groups.description: Third-party services responsible for generating vector embeddings from text, crucial for semantic search and RAG functionality.
